10.1.en: Krishna: "Listen again, because I want what's best for you, and you love me."
10.1.hi: Krishna: "Phir se suno, kyunki main tumhara bhala chahta hoon, aur tum mujhe pyaar karte ho."

10.2.en: Not even gods or great sages know where I come from. I'm their source.
10.2.hi: Devta aur bade rishi bhi nahi jaante main kahan se aaya. Main hi unka source hoon.

10.3.en: Whoever knows I'm unborn and beginningless, the Lord of all, is free from confusion and wrongdoing.
10.3.hi: Jo jaanta hai ki main ajanma, anaadi aur sabka Bhagwan hoon, woh confusion aur galti se free hai.

10.4.en: Intelligence, wisdom, patience, truth, self-control, joy, pain, fear, courage: every quality comes from me.
10.4.hi: Buddhi, gyaan, sabr, sach, self-control, khushi, dard, darr, himmat: har gun mujhse aata hai.

10.5.en: Kindness, contentment, discipline, generosity, fame and even bad reputation all arise from me.
10.5.hi: Dayaluta, santosh, tapasya, daan, naam aur badnaami bhi, sab mujhse paida hote hain.

10.6.en: The great sages and the first ancestors of humanity were born from my mind.
10.6.hi: Mahaan rishi aur insaaniyat ke pehle purvaj mere mann se paida hue.

10.7.en: Truly understand my glory and power, and your devotion becomes unshakeable.
10.7.hi: Meri mahima aur shakti sach mein samajh lo, toh tumhari bhakti atal ho jaati hai.

10.8.en: I'm the source of everything. The wise get this and love me with their whole heart.
10.8.hi: Main sabka source hoon. Gyaani ye samajhte hain aur poore dil se mujhe pyaar karte hain.

10.9.en: Their minds on me, lives centred on me, they inspire each other and talk about me. They're always happy.
10.9.hi: Unka mind mujh pe, life mujh pe centred, ek dusre ko inspire karte hain aur meri baatein karte hain. Hamesha khush.

10.10.en: To those who love me constantly, I give the understanding that brings them to me.
10.10.hi: Jo mujhe lagataar pyaar karte hain, unhe main woh samajh deta hoon jo unhe mujh tak laati hai.

10.11.en: Out of love, I light up their hearts and destroy the darkness of ignorance.
10.11.hi: Pyaar se main unke dil mein roshni karta hoon aur agyaan ka andhera mita deta hoon.

10.12.en: Arjuna: "You're the supreme reality, the highest light, the purest of all. The sages agree."
10.12.hi: Arjun: "Aap param satya ho, sabse oonchi roshni, sabse pavitra. Rishi bhi yahi kehte hain."

10.13.en: "Great seers like Narada and Vyasa said so, and now you're telling me yourself."
10.13.hi: "Narad aur Vyas jaise rishiyon ne yahi kaha, aur ab aap khud bata rahe ho."

10.14.en: "I believe everything you've said. Neither gods nor demons truly know you."
10.14.hi: "Aapne jo kaha, mujhe sab sach lagta hai. Na devta na asur aapko sach mein jaante hain."

10.15.en: "Only you know yourself, Krishna. Creator of all, God of gods."
10.15.hi: "Sirf aap khud ko jaante ho, Krishna. Sabke rachne wale, devon ke dev."

10.16.en: "Please tell me all the ways you show up in the world."
10.16.hi: "Please batao aap duniya mein kin-kin roop mein ho."

10.17.en: "How can I keep thinking of you? Where should I look to find you?"
10.17.hi: "Main aapko lagataar kaise yaad karun? Aapko kahan dhoondun?"

10.18.en: "Tell me again in detail. I can't get enough of hearing you." Arjuna is hooked.
10.18.hi: "Phir se detail mein batao. Aapko sunte hue mann nahi bharta." Arjun hooked hai.

10.19.en: Krishna: "I'll share the highlights. My glories are literally endless."
10.19.hi: Krishna: "Main highlights batata hoon. Meri mahima ka koi ant nahi."

10.20.en: I'm the self inside every heart. The beginning, middle and end of every being.
10.20.hi: Main har dil ke andar ka self hoon. Har jeev ka shuru, beech aur ant.

10.21.en: Among lights I'm the sun, among night skies I'm the moon. Wherever something shines brightest, that's me.
10.21.hi: Roshniyon mein main suraj, raat ke aasmaan mein chaand. Jo sabse zyada chamakta hai, woh main hoon.

10.22.en: Among scriptures I'm the musical Sama Veda, among senses I'm the mind, in living beings I'm consciousness.
10.22.hi: Granthon mein main sangeet wala Saam Veda, senses mein mind, aur jeevon mein chetna hoon.

10.23.en: Among Rudras I'm Shiva, among mountains I'm Meru. The best of every category is me.
10.23.hi: Rudron mein main Shiv, pahadon mein Meru. Har category ka best main hoon.

10.24.en: Among priests I'm Brihaspati, among generals Skanda, among waters the ocean.
10.24.hi: Purohiton mein main Brihaspati, senapatiyon mein Skand, jal mein samundar.

10.25.en: Among words I'm Om, among prayers I'm quiet chanting, among the unmoving I'm the Himalayas.
10.25.hi: Shabdon mein main Om, prarthanaon mein jap, sthir cheezon mein Himalaya.

10.26.en: Among trees I'm the sacred fig, among divine sages Narada, among perfected beings Kapila.
10.26.hi: Pedon mein main peepal, devrishiyon mein Narad, siddhon mein Kapil.

10.27.en: Among horses I'm the divine Uchchaihshravas, among elephants Airavata, among people the leader.
10.27.hi: Ghodon mein main Uchchaishrava, haathiyon mein Airavat, insaanon mein raja.

10.28.en: Among weapons I'm the thunderbolt, among cows the wish-fulfilling one, among serpents Vasuki.
10.28.hi: Hathiyaron mein main vajra, gaayon mein Kamdhenu, saanpon mein Vasuki.

10.29.en: Among snakes I'm Ananta, among water beings Varuna, among those who keep order, Yama.
10.29.hi: Naagon mein main Anant, jal jeevon mein Varun, niyam rakhne walon mein Yamraj.

10.30.en: Among animals I'm the lion, among birds Garuda, among demons' kids the devoted Prahlada.
10.30.hi: Jaanwaron mein main sher, pakshiyon mein Garud, daityon mein bhakt Prahlad.

10.31.en: Among moving things I'm the wind, among warriors Rama, among rivers the Ganga.
10.31.hi: Chalne wali cheezon mein main hawa, yoddhaon mein Ram, nadiyon mein Ganga.

10.32.en: I'm the start, middle and end of creation. Among sciences, self-knowledge. In a debate, honest logic.
10.32.hi: Main srishti ka shuru, beech aur ant hoon. Vidyaon mein aatma-gyaan. Bahas mein sachcha tark.

10.33.en: Among letters I'm 'A'. I'm endless time itself, and the creator who sees in every direction.
10.33.hi: Aksharon mein main 'A' hoon. Main anant samay hoon, aur har disha dekhne wala rachnakar.

10.34.en: I'm death that takes all, and the source of all that's coming. I'm fame, memory, patience and forgiveness.
10.34.hi: Main sab le jaane wali maut hoon, aur aane wale sabka source. Main yash, smriti, dhairya aur kshama hoon.

10.35.en: Among hymns I'm the Brihat Saman, among metres the Gayatri, among seasons spring.
10.35.hi: Stotron mein main Brihat Saam, chhandon mein Gayatri, ritu mein basant.

10.36.en: I'm the brilliance of the brilliant, the victory, the effort, and the goodness of good people.
10.36.hi: Main talented ki chamak, jeet, mehnat, aur achhe logon ki achhai hoon.

10.37.en: Among the Vrishnis I'm Krishna, among the Pandavas Arjuna, among sages Vyasa. Yes, Arjuna, you too.
10.37.hi: Vrishniyon mein main Krishna, Pandavon mein Arjun, muniyon mein Vyas. Haan Arjun, tum bhi.

10.38.en: I'm discipline among rulers, strategy among winners, silence among secrets, wisdom among the wise.
10.38.hi: Main shaasakon ka anushasan, jeetne walon ki neeti, raazon mein maun, aur gyaaniyon ka gyaan hoon.

10.39.en: I'm the seed of every being. Nothing moving or still exists without me.
10.39.hi: Main har jeev ka beej hoon. Chalta ya ruka, kuch bhi mere bina nahi.

10.40.en: My divine forms have no limit. This was just a small sample.
10.40.hi: Mere divya roopon ki koi seema nahi. Ye bas chhota sa sample tha.

10.41.en: Wherever you see power, beauty or greatness, that's a tiny spark of me.
10.41.hi: Jahan bhi taakat, sundarta ya mahaanta dikhe, woh meri ek chhoti si chingari hai.

10.42.en: But why all these details? Just know: I hold up this entire universe with a tiny fraction of myself.
10.42.hi: Par itni detail kyun? Bas jaan lo: main poore brahmaand ko apne ek chhote se hisse se sambhale hoon.
